title: NCCI procedure-to-procedure review flags on eight phase-one golden lines

baseline.note: The claims of format 2 had no review_flags field: no review flag was expected of them because none was compared. A before of null says so.

question: Q41
cause: Engine phase two applies the NCCI procedure-to-procedure edits of the rule release (PRD 2 point 6; PRD 11 step 3; test matrix PRC-11; ADR 0034): with apply_ncci on, a line whose code is in column 2 of an ncci_ptp record in force on its date, with the code of another line of the claim and date in column 1, carries an NCCI_PTP review flag unless the record's modifier indicator is 1 and a 59 or X modifier is on either line. These claims price under Medicare Advantage non-contracted terms (every flag on) and SYNTHETIC release 900001, whose ncci_ptp records the flags name. The independent worksheet computed the flags when format 3 added review_flags; no amount, reason, adjustment, variance or window of these lines moved.
